method: Official WordPress page https://maxiahorro.com.pe/tiendas/ (SMU Peru / Mayorsa) renders every store server-side as <div class='cards--shops' data-departament data-distrito data-lat data-lng> with name, address and hours; parsed all cards (32, raw: raw/maxiahorro/tiendas.html). Coordinates are the site's own data-lat/data-lng. 'district' is filled only where the store label names the district/city; Piura-city stores (labels like 'Piura (Grau)') are left blank for point-in-polygon. Count matches Gestión 2026-03-10 ('llega a 32 locales').
